title: Cloud Functions grading triggers use default 60s timeout against a 15-minute lock lease and sequential Vertex AI calls
impact: onSubmissionCreated and onSubmissionUpdated inherit the 60s v2 default timeout while acquiring a 15-minute grading_locks lease and grading questions sequentially; a >60s run kills the container before finally can delete the lock or set pending_review, leaving the submission stuck and locked for 15 minutes.
recommendation: Set timeoutSeconds: 300 and memory: '512MiB' on the grading triggers and grade questions with bounded concurrency and per-call timeouts.

title: onAssignmentCreated emails all students of a teacher across all courses, lacks idempotency, and defaults to disabled
impact: The student query in onAssignmentCreated filters only by teacherId and ignores assignmentData.courseId (emailing students in other classes), has no idempotency marker against duplicate trigger delivery, fires unbounded concurrent Resend calls, and defaults disableAssignmentEmails to true.
recommendation: Filter students by courseId when set, record an idempotency marker on the assignment doc, and send emails via Resend batch API or bounded concurrency.

title: onAssignmentDeleted deletes submission docs without deleting uploaded student files in Firebase Storage
impact: When an assignment is deleted, onAssignmentDeleted batch-deletes Firestore submissions docs but leaves all student attachments referenced in workFiles orphaned in Firebase Storage.
recommendation: Delete associated Firebase Storage objects in submission.workFiles before deleting the submission documents, matching /api/teacher/students/cleanup.

title: 100% duplication of scrubPII and grading pipeline between functions/src/grading.ts and src/lib/ai/* + src/app/api/grade
impact: scrubPII, gradeResponseAI, and gradeSubmission are copy-pasted from src/lib/ai/utils.ts, src/lib/ai/grading.ts, and src/app/api/grade/route.ts and have already drifted in question-type fallback handling and answer-key merging.
recommendation: Extract shared grading, PII scrubbing, and metering logic into a shared module imported by both Next.js and Cloud Functions.

title: processGrading silently swallows non-AI errors without logging, passes stale event data, and functions/src never uses firebase-functions/logger
impact: processGrading catches all errors without binding or logging the exception, passes the initial event snapshot instead of the transaction-read current doc to gradeSubmission, and all 18 log statements in functions/src use console.* (including logging plaintext student emails).
recommendation: Log caught errors via firebase-functions/logger, pass the latest current doc to gradeSubmission, and redact student emails from logs.

title: Unused RESEND_API_KEY secret bound to grading triggers, dead GradeAvailableEmail.tsx template, and cached Resend singleton
impact: onSubmissionCreated and onSubmissionUpdated bind secrets: [resendApiKey] even though grade email code at L281-L302 is commented out; GradeAvailableEmail.tsx is unused dead code with broken /dashboard links; and lib/email.ts caches the first apiKey in a module singleton.
recommendation: Remove resendApiKey from the grading triggers (or re-enable grade emails with valid URLs), remove dead template code, and key the Resend client by API key.

title: Zero test files in functions/ despite firebase-functions-test being installed
impact: firebase-functions-test is installed as a devDependency in functions/package.json but never used, there is no test script, and all 5 Cloud Function triggers have 0% test coverage.
recommendation: Add unit/emulator tests for grading.ts, billing.ts, and index.ts using firebase-functions-test and add a test script to functions/package.json.

title: deliverBillingUsage never updates attempts or lastError on billing_outbox and defaults POLAR_ENV to production
impact: billing_outbox docs are created with attempts: 0 in metering.ts:L61, but deliverBillingUsage never increments attempts or records failure details on error, and reads process.env.POLAR_ENV without defineString.
recommendation: Increment attempts and record lastError on failure in deliverBillingUsage and define POLAR_ENV using firebase-functions/params defineString.
